messages:
elaine: Heads up — over the last 8h streaming run I saw steady memory growth on the long-context workers. Not a spike, more a slow climb (~150MB / hour) until OOM. Eviction is enabled but residency keeps creeping. Anyone seen this pattern? :thinking:

matt: Yep saw similar on canary yesterday. Looks like pages are getting 'silted' — lots of small prefixes pinned and not reclaimed. Happens more with tool-loop workloads where chat keeps referencing lots of tiny tool outputs.

noah: +1. I profiled with jemalloc stats and saw arena growth even though active allocations were flat. suspect fragmentation + page-coalescing not kicking in.

elaine: Repro steps I used: long streaming chat w/ tool loop (~12m context), autosave KV every 30s, openai-style simulated user. Commands run: ```curl http://worker:6060/debug/pprof/heap > heap.pb.gz
pprof -png heap.pb.gz > heap.png
jemallocctl stats
``` Got heap profile showing increase in retained bytes not directly attributable to live objects.

matt: Did you capture slab/arena counts? On staging I saw arena_count jump and `unused` fraction hug 0.6. Also saw many small cached pages in slab freelist with nonzero refcounts.

jordan: Could be our kv page reuse heuristic: we prefer LRU by last_use_time but don't distinguish short-lived prefixes vs long-lived. If short prefixes accumulate, the heuristic keeps small pages alive. Proposed: add a decay factor for prefix frequency or age-bucket eviction.

noah: Also worth checking kernel selection/batching path — when we switch kernels for int8 kernels the per-token path delays evictions slightly (because KV commit gets deferred a tick to coalesce). That deferral in tight loops might let residency accumulate. I can run a trace for kernel-switch hotspots.

elaine: I grabbed a short perf trace during a 2h run. Attached snippet: ```perf script | head -n 50
# shows repeated calls to kv_commit_deferred -> page_pin -> reclaim_try
``` The timing looks like reclaim_try runs but fails due to fragmented pages.

matt: Can you run `runtimesrv debug pages --json` to dump page meta? I want to see page-chain lengths and pin counts. If we have long page-chains with one pinned ref, reclaim gives up.

elaine: Will do. Also trying a quick mitigation: lower KV cache ttl from 10m -> 2m on the workers to see if that stops the climb. If that helps, it's heuristic territory.

infra-bot: deploy to staging succeeded (elaine/cache-ttl-test) :white_check_mark:

jordan: If TTL helps, we should add an adaptive TTL based on prefix churn and average sequence length. Also consider a compact-on-threshold path: if arena unused > X% then trigger slab compaction (pause-ish).

noah: For data collection: please add these to the triage run: `jemalloc stats` snapshots (start/periodic/end), `pprof heap` every hour, `runtimesrv debug pages`, and a small trace of kernel switch events (kernel_select logs).

elaine: Doing that now. I'll post results in this thread. If anyone has quick probes to run in prod-lite, shout.

matt: One more idea — prefix-aware coalescer: when pages are being evicted, try merging adjacent small prefixes into reuse buckets to reduce fragmentation. Might be heavy but could be gated behind a feature flag.

elaine: Noted. I'll test TTL change first and attach snapshots. Thanks all. :pray:
